record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.original_question: For 1 <= r < \infty, Theorem 2.8 constructs traces on (L^{WEYL}_{r,\infty})^{APP}_{r,\infty} from 2^{-1/r}S_+-invariant linear forms on d_{r,\infty}(N0). Show that there are no other traces on (L^{WEYL}_{r,\infty})^{APP}_{r,\infty} beyond those provided by Theorem 2.8.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let $\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$ denote the space of bounded linear operators between Banach spaces. For a bounded operator $T\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$, the $n$-th approximation number is
$$a_n(T)=\inf\{\|T-F\|:F\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y),\ \mathrm{rank}(F)<n\},\qquad n\in\mathbb{N},$$
and the $n$-th Weyl number is
$$x_n(T)=\sup\{a_n(TA):A\in\mathcal{L}(\ell_2,X),\ \|A\|\le 1\}.$$
For $1\le r<\infty$ define the Lorentz-type Weyl operator ideal
$$\mathfrak{L}^{\mathrm{WEYL}}_{r,\infty}:=\{T:\ \|T\|^{\mathrm{WEYL}}_{r,\infty}:=\sup_{n\ge 1}n^{1/r}x_n(T)<\infty\},$$
and consider its approximation-number companion
$$(\mathfrak{L}^{\mathrm{WEYL}}_{r,\infty})^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}:=\{T:\ T\in\mathfrak{L}^{\mathrm{WEYL}}_{r,\infty}\ \text{and}\ \sup_{n\ge1}n^{1/r}a_n(T)<\infty\},$$
viewed as an operator ideal on the class of all Banach spaces.

A trace on an operator ideal $\mathfrak{A}$ is a linear functional $\tau$ defined on the components $\mathfrak{A}(X,X)$ (for all Banach spaces $X$) such that
(i) $\tau(S\circ T)=\tau(T\circ S)$ whenever both compositions belong to $\mathfrak{A}$, and
(ii) $\tau(x'\otimes x)=\langle x,x'\rangle$ for rank-one operators $x'\otimes x$.

On the sequence space
$$d_{r,\infty}(\mathbb{N}_0):=\{\xi=(\xi_n)_{n\ge0}:\ \sup_{n\ge1}n^{1/r}\xi^*_n<\infty\},$$
where $\xi^*$ is the decreasing rearrangement of $|\xi|$, consider the dyadic shift $S_+$ acting by
$$(S_+\xi)_n=\xi_{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}\quad\text{(or the analogous block-doubling shift)},$$
and call a linear form $\varphi$ on $d_{r,\infty}(\mathbb{N}_0)$ "$2^{-1/r}S_+$-invariant" if $\varphi(2^{-1/r}S_+\xi)=\varphi(\xi)$ for every $\xi\in d_{r,\infty}(\mathbb{N}_0)$.

It is known that every $2^{-1/r}S_+$-invariant linear form on $d_{r,\infty}(\mathbb{N}_0)$ induces, via a standard construction, a trace on $(\mathfrak{L}^{\mathrm{WEYL}}_{r,\infty})^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}$.

Problem. For every $1\le r<\infty$, prove that every trace on $(\mathfrak{L}^{\mathrm{WEYL}}_{r,\infty})^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}$ arises in this way from some $2^{-1/r}S_+$-invariant linear form on $d_{r,\infty}(\mathbb{N}_0)$; equivalently, show that there are no other traces on $(\mathfrak{L}^{\mathrm{WEYL}}_{r,\infty})^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}$ beyond those obtained from this construction.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is stated as an explicit open problem in a recent survey on traces of operator ideals over the class of all Banach spaces. General web search did not locate any subsequent publication classifying all traces on the ideal $(\mathfrak{L}^{\mathrm{WEYL}}_{r,\infty})^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}$; the topic is part of an active program but no resolution was found.

status_evidence.snippet: List of open problems on traces of operator ideals, including the classification problem for traces on (L^WEYL_{r,infty})^APP_{r,infty}.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is posed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Modern Applications of s-numbers and Operator Ideals (Oberwolfach Report)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Pietsch's program on s-numbers, Weyl numbers, operator ideals and traces; the full classification of traces on Weyl-type ideals over all Banach spaces is highlighted as ongoing.
status_evidence.claim: Trace classification on Weyl-type ideals on all Banach spaces is an open research direction.
